about: Shared cases for the LLM correction guardrail: LLMCorrectionGuardrail.swift (macOS) and windows/superdictate/llm/guardrail.py (Windows) must give the same verdict on every case, and carry the same model_removed_fillers list. Both self-test suites read this file; edit it, not the suites.
expect = accept: the guardrail returns the model's output (trimmed); reject: it returns the input unchanged.

model_removed_fillers: fillers the VoiceScribe corrector (Qwen3.5-0.8B + LoRA V15 R-3) deletes by design, so dropping them is an edit, not a lost word. Sources: the model card's policy ('remove filler (эм/ну/типа/короче) ... preserve all meaning'), its reference example (Эм, докер мониторит, ну, бэкенд ...), and a probe of the real model with the app's own prompt (2026-10-21, CPU, greedy, lora-scale 4.0), which also dropped э/ээ/м, «так сказать», «значит», «короче говоря». Words the model kept in that probe and that are often real words («вот», «это», «просто», «слушай», «допустим», «в общем», «как бы»...) are deliberately NOT here.
source: macos / windows = that suite's own hand-written case; probe = the real model's output from the 2026-10-21 probe; card = the model card's example.
